title.zh: 实验验证不缩放时 softmax 会饱和
title.en: An experiment showing softmax saturation without scaling

prompt.zh: 用随机向量做三个测量。点积的方差是否等于 $d_k$。16 个随机 key 上的最大注意力权重随 $d_k$ 怎样变化。通过 softmax 传回的梯度有多大。测试会检查不缩放时权重随维度增大而集中到单个位置，缩放后则保持不变。
prompt.en: Take three measurements with random vectors. Whether the variance of the dot product equals $d_k$. How the largest attention weight over 16 random keys changes with $d_k$. How much gradient passes back through the softmax. The tests check that without scaling the weights concentrate on a single position as the dimension grows, and that with scaling they stay the same.

hints.zh: query 取形状 `(n, 1, d_k)`，key 取 `(n, T, d_k)`，相乘后对最后一维求和得到 `(n, T)` 的分数。
hints.en: Use queries of shape `(n, 1, d_k)` and keys of `(n, T, d_k)`. Multiplying and summing over the last dimension gives scores of shape `(n, T)`.

hints.zh: 求梯度时先把分数变成叶子张量，即 `scores = scores.detach().requires_grad_(True)`，反向传播后读取 `scores.grad`。
hints.en: For the gradient, make the scores a leaf tensor with `scores = scores.detach().requires_grad_(True)` and read `scores.grad` after the backward pass.
